reasons.plausibility: Sluggish diffusion and phase stability are recognized phenomena in high-entropy alloys, making the explanation scientifically sound though somewhat general.
reasons.testability: Thermal exposures at different temperatures combined with microstructural and mechanical testing can directly confirm or refute the proposed link between phase decomposition and reduced strength.
reasons.usefulness: It points researchers toward investigating phase stability effects on mechanical properties, though the mechanistic detail is limited.
